Check Engine SEO 1.3.165

**Check Engine is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes) to see all the others, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *A wrong licence key now gets a plain answer.* It says the key was not recognised, tells you to copy the whole key again from your receipt email, and says where to write if you are still stuck. It no longer names the payment service or quotes a technical reason.
- *The licence-key window puts the key box first.* If you have a key you paste it straight away; if you do not, "Don't have a key yet?" and the Buy button sit underneath. There is no command-line instruction in it any more.
- *An audit says what it is doing in plain words.* "Reading your website's pages", "Checking what each page looks like" and "Working out your score" replace the raw page addresses. The buttons read "Show results so far" and "Cancel audit", and the progress bar never fills before the audit is done.
- *Problem counts agree everywhere.* Problems and notices are counted separately ("17 problems found, plus 4 notices") on the result, in the report and in the PDF, instead of three different totals.
- *The "what you could gain" sentence reads as one sentence.* "Resolving the work below could raise your score to 100/100, worth 10.8 points." no longer breaks apart in the window.
- *Smaller clean-ups.* "Save score image" is a quiet button instead of the main one; a speed result that was not measured says "not measured" in plain words; the start-up screen no longer fades over the form; a report made without a branded name ends "Made on this computer by Check Engine SEO"; the price line matches the website.
- Nothing else changed in how audits, reports or licences work. Your licence key, settings and past reports carry over as before.

99 checks across 13 areas.
